about:
Joly's Metal Works, Inc. was founded by Lucien Joly on July 9, 1979, in New Orleans, Louisiana. The company has grown from a small shop to a 26,500‑square‑foot facility (expanded to 28,500 square feet) serving customers across Louisiana and the Gulf Coast.

The shop specializes in general metal fabrication and installation, working with carbon steel, galvanized steel, stainless steel, aluminum, copper, and brass in thicknesses from 26‑gauge sheet to 2‑inch plate. A team of 35 tradesmen operates two computerized cutting systems, four press brakes, four rollers, three shears, five presses, two iron workers, an automated band saw, and an 8‑by‑22‑foot automated cutting table, supported by estimators and detailers who work from customer drawings, CAD files, or hand sketches.

Joly's serves commercial and industrial clients along the Gulf Coast, providing on‑site measuring, design assistance, and a fleet of fully equipped service vehicles for installation. The company is licensed and insured, and its staff works within project specifications and timelines.

The business was started to deliver quality metalwork with up‑to‑date technology, and it emphasizes accurate, fair pricing and the ability to handle jobs of any size from a single facility.
